questions.prompt: This lecture’s Austrian focus names especially:

questions.prompt: The labor theory of value says value derives from:

questions.prompt: Marginalists (Jevons, Walras, Menger) stress that value is:
choices: B Subjective—and tied to the Marginal Revolution’s insights.

questions.prompt: Menger’s gold-panning contrast undermines labor theory because:
choices: A More labor always means higher market value.
B Equal gold ounces can embody very different labor yet sell similarly.

questions.prompt: With more potential buyers for one good, Menger’s insight is that the price range:
choices: D Must be set by planners.
